from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Full, uniform non-background rows and columns mark panel boundaries.
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rows, cols = spans(h, hr), spans(w, vc)
    panels = []
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            panel = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if any(v != bg for row in panel for v in row):
                panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, panel))
    if not panels:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The occupied panel is the exemplar; copy it into equally sized empty panels.
    r0, r1, c0, c1, exemplar = panels[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b in rows:
        for x, y in cols:
            if (a, b, x, y) == (r0, r1, c0, c1) or b-a != r1-r0 or y-x != c1-c0:
                continue
            if all(grid[i][j] == bg for i in range(a, b) for j in range(x, y)):
                for i in range(b-a):
                    out[a+i][x:y] = exemplar[i][:]
    return out
'''
